title: Briefing for 2026-09-21
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-09-21: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: France’s wine production nears a 70-year low, leaving winemakers with tough choices. Consumer sentiment is in the dumps despite a solid economy. Goldman Sachs blames 'lower happiness'. Why Japan’s markets flipped the usual script after central bank rate hike. Bank of England defies Fed’s rate-hike lead, leaving rates unchanged. 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices. Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household.
global: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on. Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says. Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece. Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested. Converse pulls 'deeply upsetting' advert after backlash. Billionaire Man United owner loses moral high ground after tax exile, Labour chair says.
philippines: World leaders return to UN amid wars in Middle East and Ukraine. Agatha Wong shifts focus to med school after Asian Games swan song. From Beda to UP: James Payosing brings premium spark to UAAP. [Inside the Newsroom] The tip that led us inside a non-consensual porn forum.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
